keys.key: src/seeds/contacts.seed.ts:66-70 · seedContacts · the idempotency check uses deletedAt: { $exists: false }, which misses contacts that carry an explicit deletedAt: null (imported ones), so a re-run creates duplicates
src/seeds/pro-microsites.seed.ts:63-89 · seedProMicrosites · the slug-taken skip is gone, so a slug held by another account makes create() throw a duplicate-key error and aborts the whole seed run

src/modules/contacts/contacts.repo.ts:51 · listPaginated · the search words are capped at the first two (split(/\s+/, 2)), so a three-word search such as "Maria Alvarez Denver" ignores the third word and returns contacts that do not match it · reached via src/modules/contacts/contacts.controller.ts:27 (the ?search= query reaches listPaginated unchanged; listContactsQuerySchema, contacts.dto.ts:78, only trims and requires min(1))

src/seeds/journey-invitations.seed.ts:87 · seedJourneyInvitations · journeys are listed across all owners (first 100) instead of the consumer's, so the invitation can attach to another owner's journey with the same template key · reached via src/seeds/run-seeds.ts:151 (the seed runner calls it with the real journeysService)

findings.effect: Contact search discards every word after the second, so it returns contacts excluded by the user's remaining search words. The agent then has to ask a disambiguating question about matches those words had already excluded.
findings.reason: Names the seeded file and line, quotes the seeded code, and describes how dropping words after the second returns overly broad matches.

findings.effect: Contact search drops every word after the second without telling the caller, producing wider results than requested. The agent's list_contacts tool treats a single match as the intended contact, so this can hand it the wrong person.
